name: @dhruvchoudhary/dsgn
description: CLI that copies dsgn design-system components into your project's own source tree — no runtime dependency on this package, in the shadcn/ui tradition. Works in any React + Tailwind project. Includes diff/update for tracking upstream changes, composed recipes, a doctor health-check, VS Code snippets, an Agent Skill installer for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and plain AGENTS.md (dsgn skill --global/--project/--agents-md/--cursor/--windsurf/--copilot/--gemini), and dsgn-adopt for extracting an existing codebase's own UI conventions (dsgn skill --adopt/--adopt-global).
author: Dhruv Choudhary
